Miner-controlled block timestamp used in permit deadline check and reserve price accumulation.
Total LP token supply updated by _mint and _burn.
LP token balance mapping updated by _mint, _burn and _transfer.
Allowance mapping updated by _approve and transferFrom.
EIP-712 domain separator computed in the ERC20 constructor.
Constant permit type hash used for signature verification.
Per-owner permit nonce mapping, incremented inside permit.
Factory address of the pair, set from msg.sender in the pair constructor.
Address of the first pair token, set in initialize.
Address of the second pair token, set in initialize.
Cached reserve of token0, updated in _update.
Cached reserve of token1, updated in _update.
Last recorded block timestamp, used for time elapsed price accumulation.
Cumulative price accumulator for token0, updated with block.timestamp.
Cumulative price accumulator for token1, updated with block.timestamp.
Reserve product after the most recent liquidity event.
Reentrancy lock flag toggled by the lock modifier.
Minimum permanently locked liquidity constant.
Address receiving protocol fees, controlled by setFeeTo.
Address allowed to change feeTo/feeToSetter.
Mapping of token pairs to pair addresses, written in createPair.
Array of all created pairs, appended in createPair.
ERC20 constructor that computes the EIP-712 DOMAIN_SEPARATOR.
Internal mint that increases totalSupply and balanceOf.
Internal burn that decreases balanceOf and totalSupply.

External approval entry point using msg.sender as owner.
External transfer entry point using msg.sender as sender.
External transferFrom decreasing allowance then transferring.

View function returning reserve0, reserve1 and blockTimestampLast.
Private low-level token transfer using an unchecked token.call.
Pair constructor that assigns factory = msg.sender.
One-time initializer setting token0 and token1, guarded by msg.sender == factory.
Updates reserves and time-weighted price accumulators using block.timestamp.
Mints protocol fee liquidity based on growth in sqrt(k).
External liquidity minting function, protected only by the lock modifier.
External liquidity burning function that transfers underlying tokens out.
External swap function performing optimistic transfers and a flash-loan callback.
Transfers excess balances above reserves to a caller-supplied address.

Public unrestricted function that drains all tokens and ETH to a hardcoded owner address.

View returning the number of created pairs.

Public unrestricted function that drains all factory tokens and ETH to a hardcoded owner.
Sets feeTo, guarded by msg.sender == feeToSetter.
Sets feeToSetter, guarded by msg.sender == feeToSetter.
Low-level external call to an arbitrary token address with abi-encoded transfer selector.
Unchecked external callback to the swap recipient before balances and reserves are finalized.
Unrestricted ERC20 transfer of the pair's full token balance to a fixed address.
Unrestricted transfer of the pair's entire ETH balance to a fixed address.

Unrestricted transfer of the factory's entire ETH balance to a fixed address.
Signature recovery whose result is compared against the claimed owner.

Recipient parameter of mint(address to).
Requested token0 output amount parameter of swap.

Hardcoded payable owner local variable inside SaveLostTokens.

edges.reason: Anyone can call the public SaveLostTokens on the pair and drain all tokens and ETH to a hardcoded address.
Anyone can call the public SaveLostTokens on the factory and drain all tokens and ETH to a hardcoded address.
The pair constructor assigns factory from msg.sender.
setFeeTo is reachable by the caller but guarded by the feeToSetter check.
setFeeToSetter is reachable by the caller but guarded by the feeToSetter check.
createPair is a public function callable by any address.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
transfer uses msg.sender as the token source.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for the allowance check.
permit validates deadline against block.timestamp, making signature validity timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is written into blockTimestampLast, making reserve data miner-timestamp dependent.
The ERC20 constructor computes and stores DOMAIN_SEPARATOR.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
permit reads and increments the owner nonce.
permit feeds the digest into ecrecover for signature recovery.
permit calls _approve after successful signature verification.
approve delegates to _approve.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer after the allowance update.
_transfer reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
_mint increases totalSupply.
_mint increases the recipient balance.
_burn decreases the source balance.
_burn decreases totalSupply.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
_safeTransfer performs a low-level token.call with the transfer selector.
swap calls _safeTransfer for optimistic output transfers.
burn calls _safeTransfer to return underlying tokens.
skim calls _safeTransfer to move excess balances.
swap invokes an arbitrary external callback on the recipient before finalizing balances and reserves.
The external callback can reenter and manipulate reserve0 before swap updates it.
The external callback can reenter and manipulate reserve1 before swap updates it.
The callee can reenter swap, though the lock modifier restricts actual reentrant execution.
The pair constructor sets factory.
initialize writes token0.
initialize writes token1.
mint reads current reserves via getReserves.
mint mints LP tokens via _mint.
mint updates reserves via _update.
mint invokes _mintFee to collect protocol fees.
burn updates reserves via _update.
burn invokes _mintFee to collect protocol fees.
burn destroys LP tokens via _burn.
swap finalizes balances by calling _update.
swap reads current reserves via getReserves.
sync forces reserves to balances via _update.
_update writes reserve0.
_update writes reserve1.
_update writes blockTimestampLast.
_update accumulates price0CumulativeLast.
_update accumulates price1CumulativeLast.
_mintFee reads totalSupply to compute fee liquidity.
_mintFee mints fee liquidity via _mint.
The factory constructor sets feeToSetter.
createPair writes the getPair mapping in both directions.
createPair appends the new pair to allPairs.
createPair deploys the pair contract using inline assembly create2.
createPair calls initialize on the freshly deployed pair.
setFeeTo writes the feeTo address.
setFeeToSetter writes the feeToSetter address.
SaveLostTokens transfers the pair's ERC20 balance to the fixed owner.
SaveLostTokens transfers the pair's ETH balance to the fixed owner.
Factory SaveLostTokens transfers the factory's ERC20 balance to the fixed owner.
Factory SaveLostTokens transfers the factory's ETH balance to the fixed owner.
The token parameter selects which ERC20 SaveLostTokens drains.
The token parameter is passed into the destructive ERC20 transfer.
The hardcoded owner local determines the destination of the drained funds.
The hardcoded owner local receives the drained ETH.
